Round 15 · The rebuild, measured against the real thing

Look first. Measure second.

R15 closed the two oldest combat cracks at once. Aiming the gun now clearly out-kills a dead stick (the complaint that stood open since R10), and the judge flew the full climb → lock → dodge → fire missile loop by hand — a grace window holds the lock through the dodge, amber pips show what you’ve got. It rises to 8.5. And the round’s defining moment wasn’t a fix at all: the headline gap — ‘grow the sight’s reach’ — was refuted by measurement before a line of it shipped. We already over-reach the arcade.
“The two oldest combat illusion-breakers both closed — reactive aiming now clearly out-kills the blind stick, and I flew the full climb-lock-dodge-fire missile loop by hand. Honest progress against a still-fiddly first lock.”

Ours vs the arcade

stage 1 · 60 Hz capture vs mapped longplay

Shipped this round

held up under the judge’s re-measure
  • Aiming the gun BEATS the blind stick (aim 24 vs blind 12) — the complaint open since R10, closed
  • The missile is human-usable — climb → lock → dodge → fire, held by a 1.2 s lock grace window
  • A UI lock cue — amber pips under the reticle show how many locks you hold (arcade-faithful, no invented label)
  • A burst-wall density rhythm — a wall of jets then a real lull, average presence NOT inflated
  • The afterburner flame crisped into separated teardrop cones (R14 ‘long and liquid’ fixed)

Next — R16

ranked by what breaks the illusion
  1. 01 MISSING
    Breadth — 4 of 23 stages, no resupply or bonus

    Now the single biggest gap, since the combat feel is closed. Keep adding stages, and build the iconic resupply/refuel interstitial — a whole missing beat of the arcade.

  2. 02 FEEL
    The FIRST missile lock is hard to find

    Once you know the move the loop works — but the sight doesn’t auto-recentre and a full climb overshoots the lockable band, so the judge flew ~15 empty passes before discovering ‘ease up gently and park mid-height on the approaching wave.’ Make that first lock discoverable.

  3. 03 POLISH
    The stage-4 forest ground

    Reads darker and flatter than the arcade’s bright mottled canopy with its cyan river. A palette/texture pass on the forest ground.

  4. 04 POLISH
    Small climaxes and the title

    Kill fireballs still read sub-screen next to the arcade’s half-screen blasts; the title wordmark is hand-rounded where the arcade’s is brush-angular.

  5. 05 POLISH
    Loose ends

    The blind gun floor is halved but still ~8–12 (structural, the span-scaled net); the SIGHT_NDC_Y_OFFSET vulcan-vs-glyph reconciliation (+0.30 vs +0.16) is a low-priority measurement.

Keep — do not regress

  • Aiming beats the blind gun; the missile climb-lock-dodge-fire loop + grace window + pip cue
  • The burst-wall rhythm (presence not inflated); the crisp afterburner; blind-pilot protection
  • Four stages; islands; game-over; ±60° attract; the death cycle at ~8 s (arcade-confirmed)
  • Do NOT grow ENVELOPE_Y — measurement confirmed we already over-reach the arcade

R15’s defining moment was the method catching itself: the headline gap (grow the sight’s vertical reach) was REFUTED by the first-ever arcade vertical-sight measurement — we already over-reach — before a line shipped. Three independent sources agreed; the lanes redirected to the real problems (density supply + a lock grace window + a UI cue), which closed both cracks. The judge also caught an overstated grace figure (wrong probe key); withdrawn. History in judging/R15/.
